features.title: Mobile-First Design
features.description: Take your beekeeping records to the field with our responsive mobile interface. Designed for field use on your smartphone or tablet.

features.title: Apiary Management
features.description: Manage your apiaries with location tracking and organization. Keep all your hive locations organized in one place.

features.title: Hive Tracking
features.description: Monitor individual hives, their status, and configuration. Track equipment and maintain complete colony records.

features.title: Inspection Forms
features.description: Record observations with streamlined inspection forms. Quick toggles and rating scales for efficient data entry.

features.title: Queen Management
features.description: Track queen details, marking colors, and replacement history. Document queen performance and lineage over time.

features.title: Weather Integration
features.description: Record weather conditions during inspections. Track environmental factors alongside colony observations.

features.title: Treatment Tracking
features.description: Log treatments with dates and methods. Keep records of all medications and interventions.

features.title: Performance Insights
features.description: View colony strength and production trends over time. Use data to optimize your beekeeping practices.

features.title: Self-Hosted
features.description: Run Hive-Pal on your own server or local network. Keep complete control of your beekeeping data.
